## Urayuli (CR 6)

What seems like a shaggy pillar of fur lifts its arm up, its knuckles rugged from being dragged on the ground. Its eyes open, their bright glow enticing and soothing.  

**XP** 2,400  
N Large monstrous humanoid  
**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., scent; Perception +13  


**Defense**


**AC** 19, touch 10, flat-footed 18 (+1 Dex, +9 natural, –1 size)  
**hp** 66 (7d10+28)  
**Fort** +7, **Ref** +6, **Will** +6; **Resist** cold 20  


**Offense**


**Speed** 40 ft.  
**Melee** bite +14 (1d8+7), 2 slams +14 (1d6+7)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 10 ft. (15 ft. with slam)  
**Special Attacks** fascinating gaze  


**Statistics**


**Str** 24, **Dex** 13, **Con** 17, **Int** 7, **Wis** 12, **Cha** 10  
**Base Atk** +7; **CMB** +15; **CMD** 26  
**Feats** Ability Focus (fascinating gaze), Great Fortitude, [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), [Weapon Focus (bite)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (bite).*  
**Skills** Perception +13, Stealth +11, Survival +8; **Racial Modifiers** +4 Perception, +4 Stealth  
**Languages** Sylvan  


**Special Abilities**


**Fascinating Gaze (Su)** Target is fascinated, 30 feet, Will DC 15 negates. Fascination lasts as long as the urayuli remains within 30 feet of the fascinated creature and spends a swift action each turn to maintain the gaze. Any action from the urayuli, including approach and attack, doesn’t count as threatening for the purpose of breaking the fascination. This is a mind-affecting effect. The save DC is Charisma-based.  


**Ecology**


**Environment** cold forests  
**Organization** solitary, pair, or group (3-4)  
**Treasure** standard
